decisions.reason: The firm has invested in a multi-model range and given it a dedicated webpage, making it highly visible and central, with no reported problems, so it will likely keep it.
With its own webpage and a quantified launch message, the firm is publicly committed to this product and there are no problems, so dropping is unlikely.
Although less prominent than A or B, the product builds on the established offer and has a quantified launch, and with no problems the firm will maintain its commitment.
The product is mentioned on the website and builds on the established offer; despite lower visibility and no problems, the firm's existing investment and responsibility lead it to keep the product.

This generic blood pressure medication is distant from the firm's established offer and has faced a quality problem that is not clearly temporary, so the firm has less commitment and is more likely to drop it.
